name: sugar_beet

source.t_base_c: [C] AquaCrop Reference Manual v7.3 (FAO, July 2026), Annex I.7 Sugar Beet, section 1.1: Tbase 5 degC.
source.t_upper_c: [C] AquaCrop Reference Manual v7.3 (FAO, July 2026), Annex I.7 Sugar Beet, section 1.1: Tupper 30 degC.

source.stages: [D] emergence 131, row_closure 619, maturity 2212 are development units accumulated by the Python port of the model's thermal-time rule (clamped daily Tmin/Tmax, Tbase/Tupper above) along the Frankfurt/Main daily record (DWD station 01420), 1992-2024, from the year's mean sowing date to the year's mean date of the DWD phase (annual reporters of all German stations, quality level <= 3; DWD CDC opendata phenology/annual_reporters/crops), averaged over 32 seasons (DWD sugar beet phases 10 Bestellung, 12 Auflaufen BBCH 10, 13 Bestand geschlossen BBCH 35, 24 Ernte; sd 21/38/144 units; mean doys sowing 96.8, emergence 116.7, closure 162.5, harvest 282.5; the harvest is the beginning of the lifting campaign, so 'maturity' is the mean lifting date). The stage named flowering is the start of yield formation (no flowers on a beet), 1000 [C range]: AquaCrop annex I.7 section 1.3, start of yield formation at emergence + 800-1000 (here emergence + 869). Senescence 1900 [C range]: annex emergence + 1700-2300. Overripe 2500 [AS].

source.plant_density_per_ha: [C] AquaCrop Reference Manual v7.3 (FAO, July 2026), Annex I.7 Sugar Beet, section 1.2: 80 000 - 120 000 plants per hectare (management); 100 000.
source.ccx: [C] AquaCrop Reference Manual v7.3 (FAO, July 2026), Annex I.7 Sugar Beet, section 1.2: maximum canopy cover 'almost entirely covered'; 0.95.
source.cgc_per_gdd: [C] AquaCrop Reference Manual v7.3 (FAO, July 2026), Annex I.7 Sugar Beet, section 1.2: canopy growth coefficient 0.010-0.012 per GDD; the upper end, because with 0.011 the canopy reached half cover at about 740 units after emergence while the DWD row closure (BBCH 35) is at 488 units after emergence.
source.cdc_per_gdd: [C] AquaCrop Reference Manual v7.3 (FAO, July 2026), Annex I.7 Sugar Beet, section 1.2: canopy decline coefficient 0.003-0.004 per GDD.

source.rue_g_mj: [AS] light-use efficiency of sugar beet, 1.8 g per MJ of global radiation (total dry matter): Scott and Jaggard (about 1.8 g/MJ intercepted solar radiation), recalled, not looked up.
source.rue_t_low_c: [AS] the light-use efficiency starts at the base temperature 5 degC ...
source.light_primary: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for sugar_beet, not crop-specific (wheat entry: 1: the daily gain is the light potential x Tr/Tr_potential (the water factor of the AquaCrop gain, Tr = transpiration, Tr_potential = Kcb x ET0), WP* is then not used for the gain. 0: the smaller of the light potential and WP* x Tr/ET0. With 0 and the ramp below the harvest was 14 % under the DESTATIS mean at the same BBCH 31 biomass (F1d part 1); with 1 the same early biomass keeps the yield, bec)
source.co2_response: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for sugar_beet, not crop-specific (wheat entry: AquaCrop Reference Manual v7.3 (FAO, July 2026), chapter 3, Table 3.11c/1 (Eq. 3.11c): multiplier of WP* for a C3 crop (f_type = 1) over the atmospheric CO2 concentration, the FACE-based column (fsink 0); WP* is normalised to 369.41 ppm (the year 2000). Applied to WP* and, as photosynthesis, to rue. The crop's f_type = clamp((40 - WP*)/20, 0, 1) (Eq. 3.11d).)

source.hi0: [C] AquaCrop Reference Manual v7.3 (FAO, July 2026), Annex I.7 Sugar Beet, section 3.2: reference harvest index 65-75 % (root dry matter over aboveground-plus-root dry matter); 0.68; Bas22 beet:leaf gives 0.646.
source.hi_build_gdd: [D] development units from the yield formation stage to maturity of the stage table (2212 - 1000).
source.flowering_length_gdd: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for sugar_beet, not crop-specific (wheat entry: AquaCrop Reference Manual v7.3 (FAO, July 2026), Annex I.10 Wheat, section 1.3: length of the flowering stage 150-280 GDD; 200 inside the range.)
source.excess_fruits_pct: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for sugar_beet, not crop-specific (wheat entry: AquaCrop Reference Manual v7.3 (FAO, July 2026), Annex I.10 Wheat, section 3.2 lists 'medium' without a number; 50 % is the value of the manual's own worked example (AquaCrop Reference Manual v7.3, chapter 3 (calculation procedures), section 3.12, Fig. 3.12i).)
source.ppol: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for sugar_beet, not crop-specific (wheat entry: AquaCrop Reference Manual v7.3 (FAO, July 2026), Annex I.10 Wheat, section 4.1: pollination fails above a depletion of 0.85 of TAW (estimate); Ks_pol,w falls linearly to 0 at TAW (AquaCrop Reference Manual v7.3, chapter 3 (calculation procedures), section 3.12).)
source.sto_coefficient_b: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for sugar_beet, not crop-specific (wheat entry: coefficient b of the negative effect of stomatal closure during yield formation (AquaCrop Reference Manual v7.3, chapter 3 (calculation procedures), section 3.12, Eq. 3.12m/n: 1 = strong effect .. 20 = small effect); Annex I.10 section 3.2 gives only 'moderate' for wheat. 7 (recalled default crop file) is inside the range. The functional form (HI factor = mean of 1 - (1 - Ks_sto^(1/10))/b) is [C];)

source.logistic_steepness: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for sugar_beet, not crop-specific (wheat entry: the manual says the temperature Ks curves are logistic (section 3.2.3) but prints no equation; this is the steepness of a logistic rescaled to hit 0 and 1 at the limits.)
source.straw_harvest_fraction: [D] LfL Bayern Bas22 (Basisdaten Duengung und Naehrstofffluesse, 10.12.2021) Tab. 1a: sugar beet leaves (Blatt) are 0.7 dt per dt beet at 18 % dry matter against 23 % for the beet: leaf dm 0.126 t per t beet, non-grain biomass at HI 0.68 is 0.47 per unit root dm = 0.108 t; all of it can be taken, capped at 0.95.
source.pollination: [AS] a root crop has no pollination: 0 switches the pollination factor off (the harvest index builds from the stage named flowering = start of yield formation).

source: F1d sugar beet (family beet). Annex I.7 Sugar Beet values of the AquaCrop reference manual v7.3 are [C]; the stage table is [D] from DWD phenology (sowing and emergence of the annual reporters, row closure) and the Frankfurt station; nutrient removal is [D] from LfL Bayern Bas22. The yield is the root dry matter (AquaCrop: 'sugar beet yield is expressed as dry matter'; fresh matter = dry matter / 0.23 for the Bas22 beet at 23 %% dry matter). A root crop: harvest index builds from the 'flowering' stage (= start of yield formation), no pollination (yield.pollination 0; the pollination keys are required by the loader and unused).
